attributes.title: By detector (TPC / ITS / MCH)
attributes.description: InfoLogger records for a given detector.

attributes.title: One host — edit origin_host:epnNNN
attributes.description: One EPN's whole story; pairs with 'View surrounding documents'. origin_host is stamped on all three sources.

attributes.title: By subsystem (ODC / DPL)
attributes.description: InfoLogger records for a given O2 subsystem.

attributes.title: stdout crashes
attributes.description: Error/Fatal lines from the O2 process stdout family.

attributes.title: Active alerts — what fired
attributes.description: Every alert currently open, newest first: which rule fired, which trigger, and how serious it is.

attributes.title: Anomalies — what looks wrong, and where
attributes.description: One row per anomalous window, newest first. 'about' says what the detector watches, 'scope' says which host or collector it was watching. Real-time results only — a historical analysis run now would otherwise be counted as something happening now.

attributes.title: Signals — every raw row behind an incident
attributes.description: One lossless row per source signal. Grouping never destroys these: an incident references them, it does not replace them.

attributes.title: Open episodes — complete detail
attributes.description: One row per deduplicated open episode. Raw alerts and anomaly windows are evidence in alice-signals, not separate operational problems.

attributes.title: Episode history — every episode of one incident
attributes.description: One row per episode of the same recurring problem, newest first. The card's Details button opens this filtered to its own incident_id, so you see how often it came back.

attributes.title: Recent resolved episodes
attributes.description: Deduplicated episodes that have recovered, newest first.

{"title": "Act on this", "type": "markdown", "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": false, "markdown": "### ⚙️ Act on this
This dashboard is read-only. To acknowledge, mute or edit a rule:

**[Alerts →](/app/alerting#/dashboard)** — acknowledge an alert so it stops counting as active.

**[Monitors →](/app/alerting#/monitors)** — change a threshold, or disable a rule that is crying wolf.

**[Anomaly detectors →](/app/anomaly-detection-dashboards#/detectors)** — per-detector history, the feature values behind a grade, and initialisation state.

Acknowledging is not the same as fixing: the rule will fire again on the next window that still breaches it."}, "aggs": []}
